name: Axiom Executive Helicopter
description: A conventional helicopter upgraded with modern materials and silent-running blade technology. The Exec Helo exists because some Tier 5 executives prefer the proven reliability of rotary wing over anti-grav — when your life depends on not falling out of the sky, some people trust the physics they understand. Quieter than legacy helicopters but louder than VTOL craft, the Exec Helo is becoming a retro-luxury choice. Its distinctive blade wash announces arrival like a herald.
propulsion: Twin electric turboshaft, five-blade main rotor
armament: None standard. Countermeasure suite on executive protection variant.
common_usage: Executive transport, inter-facility transit, corporate event arrival.
story_hooks: An Exec Helo is forced down by something that jams its electronics over a Tier 1 district, stranding a CEO among people who know exactly who they work for
The silent-running blade technology on an Exec Helo contains components manufactured in a facility that Axiom claims doesn't exist
physical_description: The Axiom Executive Helicopter cuts a sleek silhouette against GLMZ's grey skyline—carbon-composite fuselage in matte charcoal with brushed titanium accents, its four-blade rotor system wrapped in acoustic dampening panels that mute its signature whump to a whisper. Rain beads on its reinforced canopy; the interior visible through tinted windows glows soft amber from leather and recessed LED strips. Despite cutting-edge materials, wear shows in micro-scratches across the hull and the faint salt-stain residue from the lake winds.
